lines.zh: 我的腿不听使唤，像灌了菌。
lines.en: My legs won't obey, as if filled with sculk.
My shadow is faster; it arrived first.

lines.zh: 我已经用最快的速度在挪了。
lines.en: I'm already moving as fast as I can.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，那时还有巢。
lines.en: I walked this road when there was still a hive.

lines.zh: 我身子底下孵着一窝卵。
lines.en: A clutch of eggs hatches beneath my body.
altar... I can't go back.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，数到忘了孵卵。
lines.en: I count my steps until I forget the eggs.
Which way? Where is the hive?

lines.zh: 我一步又一步，走向卵堆。
lines.en: Step by step, I move toward the egg pile.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我不冷，卵怕冷。
lines.en: The wind rises; I'm not cold, but the eggs are.

lines.zh: 我脚底的草，全被菌丝吸干了。
lines.en: The mycelium has drained the grass under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的关节里塞满了泥和菌。
lines.en: My joints are packed with mud and sculk.
Quiet—too quiet; the eggs have stopped rattling.

lines.zh: 站到天荒地老，也得孵完。
lines.en: I'll stand till the world ends if I must, to finish.
I have forgotten why I woke.
The sun can't warm my sculk shell.
What is in the eggs has not stirred yet.
The eggs inside me are close to hatching.
Are the larvae crying? No.

lines.zh: 谁点着了灯，我的卵怕光。
lines.en: Who lit the lamp? My eggs fear light.

lines.zh: 一百点血，全用来孵东西。
lines.en: All hundred health goes into hatching things.

lines.zh: 风停了，我的孵囊也静了。
lines.en: The wind stopped, and my brood sac went still.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我的幼体就到你脚边。
lines.en: You turn, and my brood is at your feet.

lines.zh: 你身后有人，也被感染了。
lines.en: Someone behind you is infected too.
Your name — heard and forgotten.

lines.zh: 你认识这具孵过无数卵的身体吗？
lines.en: Do you know this body that has incubated countless eggs?

lines.zh: 我好久没见过这么红的脸。
lines.en: I haven't seen such a red face in a long time.
Don't run; you can't leave the sculk bed.

lines.zh: 你还带着体温，正好暖卵。
lines.en: You still carry body heat—just right to warm the eggs.

lines.zh: 我闻你的气味很浓，像能孵的东西。
lines.en: Your scent is thick, like something I could incubate.

lines.zh: 我们见过，那时我还没孵卵。
lines.en: We've met—before I incubated eggs.
Do not fear; I only came to check the brood.
Crack me open and the brood comes out.
Back off—the eggshells are thin.
Shell cracked, the brood still moves.
That landed on bone.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的幼体，被我护着。
lines.en: I curl around the brood inside me.
Don't touch the wound; the sculk will reach the eggs.
I haven't fallen apart; keep incubating.
A little numb—good, the eggs are numb too.
I've remembered that foot of yours.
In life, I never guarded eggs.

lines.zh: 金子在发光，我的幼虫想要。
lines.en: The gold is shining; my larvae want it.

lines.zh: 饥饿没有底，孵囊也没有。
lines.en: Hunger has no bottom, and neither does my brood sac.
Bone. I want bone.

lines.zh: 这东西能吃吗？先喂幼虫。
lines.en: Is this edible? Feed it to the larvae first.

lines.zh: 腐肉比面包香，幼虫也这么想。
lines.en: Rotten meat smells better than bread—my larvae agree.

lines.zh: 别拿走，那枚卵我还没孵完。
lines.en: Don't take it—I haven't finished incubating that egg.
I'm gritting my teeth—did you hear?
The smell of blood tightens my brood sac.
I carry a brood in my belly.
My belly is full of brood. Do not touch.
I move aside and slide slowly to the eggs.
You're too hot—you'll cook the eggs.
You bumped into my brood sac.
An apology. I think that's right.
Is that a challenge? Noted.

lines.zh: 我的骨头响了一声，卵也动了。
lines.en: My bone cracked once, and the eggs stirred.

lines.zh: 看路啊，活人，别踩我的卵。
lines.en: Watch your step, living one—don't crush my eggs.
Back off; my brood is at my feet.
This armor of mine is a brood's shell.

lines.zh: 一百点生命，撑得住孵化。
lines.en: A hundred health is enough to hatch.

lines.zh: 我记不起怎么温柔地孵卵。
lines.en: I can't remember how to incubate gently.
The brood is almost ready.

lines.zh: 你要是也死了，我就能一起孵。
lines.en: If you died too, we could incubate together.

lines.zh: 我的手一伸，就掉下幽匿。
lines.en: When I reach out, sculk falls from my hands.

lines.zh: 下辈子，我早点回来孵卵。
lines.en: Next life, I'll return earlier to incubate.
Closer—no, the eggs will break.
This body can hatch only insects.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的幼体，不会孤单。
lines.en: The brood inside me is never lonely.
Standing is fine. Just don't get close.

lines.zh: 永恒我有，孵卵的时间也有。
lines.en: I have eternity, and time enough to incubate.

lines.zh: 这味道，像活人刚抱过卵。
lines.en: This smells like a living person just held the eggs.
Pick it up, do not let your hand shake.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲掉了一块，先不管。
lines.en: A plate fell off my shoulder; never mind.

lines.zh: 指尖的菌丝抓不住东西。
lines.en: Sculk threads on my fingers can't grip.
This lump could hatch something.
Take it back and bury it in the sculk bed.

lines.zh: 我的口袋破了，装不住卵。
lines.en: My pocket is torn and won't hold eggs.

lines.zh: 我从土里翻出这枚冷卵。
lines.en: I dug this cold egg out of the soil.
What hatches doesn't know me.
Both arms hold eggs — nothing to pick up.

lines.zh: 我的卵，已经裂开一道缝。
lines.en: My eggs have already cracked open.
Whoever moves first goes into the eggs first.
We'll go slowly—don't crush the eggs.
Little claws poke from the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 我肚子里有东西要出来。
lines.en: Something in my belly wants out.

lines.zh: 别怕，很快你就能喂饱它们。
lines.en: Don't fear; soon you'll feed them all.
Run—my larvae are waking.

lines.zh: 我肚子里，全是待孵的卵。
lines.en: My belly is full of eggs waiting to hatch.
I'm carrying a whole brood inside.
Stand still and let me measure you.
Living one, halt—don't step on my eggs.
A hundred health, all for hatching brood.

lines.zh: 卵在背上，追上你只是时间。
lines.en: Eggs on my back, reaching you is only time.

lines.zh: 你，终于走到我的孵化室。
lines.en: You—at last you reached my hatchery.
These eggs are mine to watch.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的味道，很新鲜。
lines.en: I smell the scent on you—very fresh.

lines.zh: 你心跳太吵，会惊动幼虫。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is too loud; it will startle the larvae.

lines.zh: 你的影子到哪，我的幼虫到哪。
lines.en: Wherever your shadow goes, my larvae follow.

lines.zh: 慢慢跑，别摔进我的卵堆。
lines.en: Run slowly; don't fall into my egg pile.

lines.zh: 你留下的气味，盖过了菌床。
lines.en: Your lingering scent overpowers the sculk bed.
Even with a broken leg, I will crawl back to the hive.

lines.zh: 孵化口一张，幼体就要出来。
lines.en: One crack of the hatch and the brood comes out.

lines.zh: 你踩进孵化室，就已经输了。
lines.en: You stepped into the hatchery—you've already lost.
Stand still; my brood sac is swelling.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，惊得卵在响。
lines.en: Your footsteps make the eggs rattle.

lines.zh: 幽匿不怕光，你躲也没用。
lines.en: Sculk does not fear light; hiding is useless.
Six points of sculk armor.
The more you run, the hungrier my brood sac.
I don't tire; incubation never stops.
My belly is full of brood.

lines.zh: 别跑太快，我的幼虫追不上。
lines.en: Don't run so fast; my larvae can't keep up.

lines.zh: 喘吧，我等你喘完再收卵。
lines.en: Gasp all you want; I'll gather the eggs after.

lines.zh: 幽匿质量在这里堆起来。
lines.en: Sculk mass piles up here.
Six points of sculk plate.

lines.zh: 回头看看我，我的卵在动。
lines.en: Turn and look—my eggs are moving.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉，我的幼虫饿了。
lines.en: You can't escape; my larvae are hungry.

lines.zh: 我从巢里追你追了很久。
lines.en: I have chased you long from the nest.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，踩到我的卵。
lines.en: You stepped back onto my eggs.

lines.zh: 这具身体只剩孵卵的用处。
lines.en: This body is good only for incubating.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨甲，孵的是同类。
lines.en: This bone shell of mine hatches my kin.

lines.zh: 你看，我这副架子还能打。
lines.en: See? This frame can still fight.
Move aside; don't block my hatching path.

lines.zh: 咔哒，这一声你听清了吗。
lines.en: Click, did you hear that?
I saved this blow to feed the larvae.
Don't scream; it's too loud and wakes the larvae.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我的孵囊还满。
lines.en: One more—my brood sac is still full.
One hundred points, heavy as stone.
My claws are too sharp to hold back.
Bone hits bone, and the eggshells rattle.
Take this blow—and don't touch the brood sac.
When I fall, let it be gently.

lines.zh: 我这身甲六层，够你砍一阵。
lines.en: Six layers of me; that will take a while.
Don't dodge; stand still and let me incubate you.

lines.zh: 我记得这片天，也记得巢。
lines.en: I remember this sky, and this hive.
The brood hatched. Their legs are soft.

lines.zh: 我醒来第一件事：饿，还有孵。
lines.en: My first acts on waking: hunger, then incubation.
Fingers first—good, the eggs moved too.

lines.zh: 我回来了，带着一窝新卵。
lines.en: I'm back with a clutch of new eggs.

lines.zh: 又是这副身体，又是这窝卵。
lines.en: This body again, and this clutch again.

lines.zh: 脚下是土，熟悉得像孵囊。
lines.en: Soil underfoot, familiar as a brood sac.
The soil loosens and the brood crawls out.
How long did I sleep? Have the eggs gone cold?
Dark already? Perfect for incubating the next batch.

lines.zh: 活着的人，别靠近我的卵。
lines.en: Living one, stay away from my eggs.

lines.zh: 这地方变了，巢却不在了。
lines.en: This place has changed, but the hive is gone.

lines.zh: 谁把我从菌毯下叫醒的。
lines.en: Who woke me from beneath the sculk mat?
The light is too bright; it will spoil my eggs.
Fire! I hate fire—and the eggs fear it.
I shattered; now I must piece myself together.
Hatching in water is not so bad.
That was loud enough to shake the eggs.
An arrow sank into my egg sac.
Magic gnaws at me, and at the eggs.
So empty my belly echoes.

lines.zh: 雷落在我卵上，我护不住全部。
lines.en: Lightning struck my eggs; I cannot shield them all.
In the void, both eggs and soil are gone.
